source_pages: printed p.58-60 / PDF 60-62, read from 100-dpi renders 2026-09-26
family_naming_note: Namespaced 'Tangram H.84', not 'H.84': Maxima's H.84 (printed p.49-56) is not extracted, and a shared family name would merge family keys across two collections. Tangram's straight runs ARE Maxima modules (brochure: 'modules M represent the Maxima modularity') - those come from base_h84 when it is read, not from here.
extraction_note: All six base positions on printed p.58-60 and all six codes. Prices are NOT held here: Tangram prints its own four finish columns (silk-effect, structured, metallic-effect anodyc, oak/walnut) and a second door, 'Groove', at higher points - see claude/tangram-recon-2026-09-26.md.

data.plinth_note: H.84 on 6. The plinth tracks the HEIGHT FAMILY (base_h78.json plinth_note: Project Guidelines printed p.90 prints 6 for H.84), and the brochure kitchen planning 2026 (PDF 5) dimensions Tangram 84 over 6. Tangram's plinth is its OWN article per module - ZOCCT0A..E, 'plinth + joint + blink for all the finishes' - because it follows the curve.
page_observations: printed p.58 heads the page 'Base units H. 84' and draws six units; only the spice-rack is straight
every curved unit is doors and shelves: no drawers, no sink base, no cooktop base in Tangram - a cooktop in a Tangram island stands on a straight Maxima module

tangram_module_a.description: Tangram Module A - quarter-round, 1 rh/lh door, 2 shelves
tangram_module_a.source_ref: printed p.58 (drawing) and p.59-60 (code, contents) / PDF 60-62
tangram_module_a.not_buildable_reason: CURVED, and THE ENGINE DOES NOT DRAW CURVES YET: its builder makes boxes, and a box at this footprint would be a wrong shape that looks settled. The plan now exists - plan_geometry, measured from the brochure vector plan (trust stated there) - and tools/tangram_place.rb draws it as a planning volume. Factory confirmation of the curve (a Cesar SKP or Elda) is still owed before an order.
tangram_module_a.notes: Footprint 35 x 35 on printed p.58. THE CODE READS 030 AND THE PAGE DIMENSIONS 35 - explicit rows are the authority, as the manifest warns for B80400.
tangram_module_a.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-09-26 on the renders of printed p.58-61: no 'Hung version' glyph beside any Tangram position. A curved unit stands on its own curved plinth article (ZOCCT0x), so false is also the only reading that fits the page.

plan_geometry.frame: x along the straight back from the left end as the brochure draws it, y from the back toward the front; mirror for the other hand (all modules are rh/lh, brochure PDF p.6)
plan_geometry.trust: MEASURED FROM AN ILLUSTRATION - not a printed dimension. About +/-10 mm; enough for a preliminary presentation model, not for an order or a worktop template.
plan_geometry.source: sources/factory/folder-kitchen-planning-2026_iten-_1.pdf PDF p.6 (Tangram modularity, plan view) - VECTOR paths, not a picture
plan_geometry.method: Printed dimensions (printed p.58) fix the widths and end depths; the curve radius is MEASURED from the brochure's vector plan on PDF p.6 by fitting circles to its Bezier curves, at a scale confirmed on every module with a printed size (0,855 pt per cm, within ~1 %). The resulting carcass outline was checked against the brochure outline: they differ by the 22 mm front plus drawing artifacts (Hausdorff distance given per module). The outline is the CARCASS; the 22 mm front stands outside it.
